cohort: 429 neonates with a gestational age greater than 34 weeks who were started on empiric antibiotics within 72 hours of life, from two neonatal intensive care units in Malaysia
finding: Empiric antibiotic de-escalation in late preterm and term neonates with suspected early onset sepsis resulted in significantly shorter durations of antibiotic use compared to non-de-escalation, without differences in treatment outcomes.
mod_finding: Cesarean section delivery was positively associated with antibiotic de-escalation.
